name: valve_citadel_door_big
note: EP1 Citadel slatted Combine door (ep1_citadel_03, the airlock from the core lift to the core): an opening 192 wide and 192 high in a Combine metal frame, shut by ten thin func_door slats (2 to 26 thick, 16 to 70 wide, 192 or 224 high) layered at different depths and overlapping, 37 brushes; they all rise into the head, each its own speed (60 to 100) and lip, one after another over 2.3 s, and come down in another order. Taken shut as static slabs ('live': the leaf's name). Anchor: the opening's centre on the floor, on the wall plane (x 1834 in Valve's map); you come from -x and go out at +x. Wiring in 'wiring' (open and close relays, the two triggers, a one-way clip, the areaportal): read prefabs.md, 'Pieces with their wiring'. One slat is named door_comb_1_8 (the other door's): Valve's slip, rename it door_comb_2_9 and give it to the relays.
